name: Eye of Vecna

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book. Artifact random properties use the game's condensed tables (deviations.md).

summary: Vecna's eye: Truesight 120 ft and X-ray vision, and dreadful spells (DC 18), for one who gouges out their own eye.
text: Vecna, whose name is still only ever whispered, was among the greatest wizards who ever lived and built a dread empire through conquest and dark sorcery, yet he came to fear death and sought every means to escape it. Attuning to his Eye means tearing out one of your own eyes and seating the Eye in the vacant socket. Once attuned, you have Truesight with a 120-foot range, and solid matter is no barrier to your sight, exactly as with a Ring of X-ray Vision. Once per dawn each, you can cast these spells through the Eye (save DC 18): Eyebite, Disintegrate, Clairvoyance, Dominate Monster and Crown of Madness. It also bears four random properties: a minor and a major beneficial one, and a minor and a major detrimental one. Should it ever be taken out, it whispers to you until you put it back.
